key.name: theme
key.description: Follow the system color scheme ("default") or force the light or dark style regardless of the OS setting.

key.name: ui-tier
key.description: "simple" shows what a game is made of — every template, the basic fields of every component — and counts the rest into a "Show N more settings" row; "full" shows every component, field, template and technical detail. A fact about the person at the keyboard: it follows them across projects and is never shared with collaborators.

key.name: show-grid-default
key.summary: Show the tile grid in new sessions
key.description: The state `win.toggle-grid` starts in. The grid itself stays a per-session toggle — flipping it in a map does not change this preference — so the two never fight: this is only what the editor opens with. Like the view tier, a fact about the person at the keyboard rather than about the project.

key.name: collab-name
key.summary: The name you appear as to collaborators
key.description: Shown on your row in Together and above your cursor on everyone else's screen. Empty means "whatever the system calls me" (the account's real name, else its login), which is why the default is not stored: a derived value written on first run would freeze this machine's login into the settings of a user who never chose it, and would stop tracking an account rename.

key.name: collab-colour
key.summary: The colour of your cursor and roster dot
key.description: One of the eight collaborator colours, as a "#rrggbb" token. Empty means the colour derived from this peer's id — the hash every participant computed for itself before colours could be chosen. A value outside the palette is ignored on read, so the AI collaborator's purple cannot be claimed by a human.

key.name: collab-visible-nearby
key.summary: Advertise a shared session on the local network
key.description: When on, hosting publishes the session over mDNS so people on the same Wi-Fi find it without typing a code. When off, the session still runs and the code still works — it is simply not announced.

key.name: collab-assistant-enabled
key.summary: Let the AI collaborator edit with you
key.description: The persistent side of the Pause control in Together: off means every new session starts with the assistant paused. Pausing from the dialog writes here too, so the two cannot disagree.

key.name: coach-marks-seen
key.description: Ids of the coach marks the editor has shown, so each appears once, on the first new game. "Show tips again" in Preferences empties the list. A fact about the person at the keyboard: it follows them across projects and is never shared with collaborators.
